area_description: Benachteiligungen treten häufig nicht isoliert auf. Faktoren wie Einkommen, Bildung, Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Wohnort können zusammenwirken und die Lebens- und Teilhabechancen von Menschen in besonderem Maße beeinflussen. Die Betrachtung sich überschneidender Benachteiligungen geht daher über die Analyse einzelner Ungleichheiten hinaus und berücksichtigt, dass bestimmte Bevölkerungsgruppen mehrfachen und miteinander verbundenen Nachteilen ausgesetzt sein können.

en.national_indicator_available: People at risk of poverty or social exclusion
en.area_description: Deprivations often do not occur in isolation. Factors such as income, education, gender, age, background or place of residence can interact and have a significant impact on people’s life chances and opportunities for participation. Examining intersecting disadvantages therefore goes beyond the analysis of individual inequalities and takes into account the fact that certain population groups may be exposed to multiple and interlinked disadvantages.
en.info: According to the EU definition, a person is considered to be at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE) if at least one of the following three conditions applies: their income is below the at-risk-of-poverty threshold, their household is affected by significant material and social deprivation, or they live in a household with very low labour force participation. For each of these life situations, the proportion of the population affected can be determined.
